input.question: How do people who went through transsexual procedures change their voice?
input.ground_truth: Basically it's hormones. Women who transition to men will notice a bigger change in their voice when they start taking male hormones. But, men who transition after they've gone through puberty won't be able to change as much because the physical changes the voice box goes through at that time are hard to undo.

They might also use a little machine called a voice trainer to help their voice get used to the new way. It takes time and practice, just like learning to ride a bike or drawing a picture!
